svg.title: Dashboards: a team’s reports on one page — SoftTrack web design mockup (#331)
svg.desc: A dashboard is a named page of tiles on a team, private or shared: saved reports, built-in charts, and single numbers with their change on the previous period. One range governs the page, tiles are arranged by dragging or with the keyboard, each opens its report, and a tile that fails does so in its own space.

svg.text: Done when a team has dashboards, private or shared, with a link; when a tile is a saved report, a built-in chart or a single number with its change; when tiles are one or two
columns wide in a grid of up to three, reordered by pointer and keyboard and stacked on a phone; when one range applies to every tile that shows time unless a tile keeps its own;
when the Reports tab can land on a dashboard an admin chooses; and when tiles load independently.
